tasks.short: Regulate grazing, issue permits, check compliance and help plan grazing systems.

steps.what: Assess actual rangeland conditions, resource limits and applicable grazing requirements
inputs: actual land condition and current standards
actual grazing request
outputs: actual checked resource conditions and grazing constraints

steps.what: Help ranchers plan and organise actual grazing systems and chosen use limits
inputs: actual checked resource conditions and grazing constraints
actual rancher plans and operational constraints
outputs: actual chosen grazing plan and proposed permit particulars

steps.what: Populate the fixed grazing permit draft from verified particulars and chosen plan
inputs: actual chosen grazing plan and proposed permit particulars
actual verified applicant and parcel records
outputs: generated complete final grazing permit draft and recipient

steps.what: Review generated final permit, determine lawful conditions and authorise its exact issue
inputs: generated complete final grazing permit draft and recipient
actual checked resource conditions and grazing constraints
actual chosen grazing plan and proposed permit particulars
outputs: authorised generated final permit version and recipient

steps.what: Issue the exact authorised grazing permit to the named rancher
inputs: authorised generated final permit version and recipient
outputs: actual issued grazing permit and issue record

steps.what: Check actual grazing compliance against issued conditions and applicable standards
inputs: actual issued grazing permit and issue record
actual observed grazing and resource conditions
outputs: actual compliance observations and required follow-up

steps.what: Write and check actual grazing compliance findings and retain the internal record
inputs: actual compliance observations and required follow-up
outputs: checked saved actual compliance record

tasks.design: Configure fixed permit population in grazing-permit {OPS_SYSTEM} from actual verified records and the chosen plan. Keep land assessment, rancher planning, the existing legal review of the generated final permit, explicit issue and actual subsequent compliance work; issue and ordinary internal saves earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fixed permit particulars may be repeatedly entered after planning.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field mappings can prepare a complete fixed draft without deciding eligibility.
tasks.still_hard: Resource limits, actual conditions and compliance need accountable judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager adjusts grazing advice when actual land conditions contradict the planned use.
tasks.altitude: Less permit population; grazing and legal decisions stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed permit fields can be populated from verified records while grazing assessment and legal issuance remain human.

assumptions: Provisional permit-authority route requiring actual repeated fixed-form population15; existing autofill receives zero credit. s4 is the existing legal check of a tool-generated final permit, not an added self-approval of manager-authored notes. Any bespoke manager-authored terms remain manual and require reweighting.

Applicant/land-record owners supply actual applicant id, parcel id, period and verified details; manager supplies actual assessed limits and chosen plan through s1/s2, with manual clarification for missing facts. No free observation capture. s6 occurs only after real issue and actual grazing, never inferred from the permit. Written compliance findings and ordinary internal save are separate and fully retained. No rancher labour enters focal savings.
unknowns: What permit preparation is already native and does this manager hold issue authority?
research_questions: Can fixed drafts preserve exact parcel, period and assessed-use limits without deciding eligibility?

incremental.description: Maintain permit field mappings, current layout and access.

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact generated final permit, conditions and named recipient reviewed and authorised in s4; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes15 repeated fixed-form population points minus0.8 upkeep=14.2. Low: a new grazing arrangement needs bespoke manual conditions and parcel detail, leaving only4 existing identity/period population points removable, minus0.8=3.2. Land checks, rancher planning, complete legal review, actual issue and compliance work retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop technical standards and specifications for rangeland natural resources.

steps.what: Locate current rangeland evidence, prior standards and applicable technical source versions
inputs: actual standards-development question
actual current range evidence and standards
outputs: located current technical source packet

steps.what: Develop actual technical criteria, resource safeguards and specifications from evidence
inputs: located current technical source packet
actual range-management needs
outputs: chosen technical standards, specifications and evidence rationale

steps.what: Write explanatory standards text from chosen criteria and actual evidence
inputs: chosen technical standards, specifications and evidence rationale
outputs: complete source-linked technical standards draft

loop.purpose: Draft explanations of already chosen technical criteria
loop.input: manager-selected specifications, evidence and fixed document sections
loop.output: source-linked explanatory draft without new criteria
loop.check: Manager checks normative force, exceptions, thresholds, source meaning and omitted resource safeguards against chosen criteria
loop.stop: Missing rationale, changed criterion or two failed revisions returns affected text to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Test native standard sections first; varied technical explanations need semantic drafting and checking

steps.what: Complete and check all standards and specifications and save the final internal draft
inputs: complete source-linked technical standards draft
chosen technical standards, specifications and evidence rationale
outputs: checked saved final internal technical standards draft

tasks.design: Configure current source links and native standards sections in {DOCS}, then draft only explanations of manager-chosen technical criteria. Retain actual standard development and full final checking, with an ungated ordinary internal save; no formal adoption or publication is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current source locating and explanatory drafting can repeat around new technical decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and constrained source-linked drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Technical thresholds and protection criteria require evidence-based judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager identifies a specification that protects average sites but fails vulnerable ones.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation and descriptive drafting; standard-setting judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked drafting can assist explanations of chosen technical standards while scientific criteria remain human decisions.

assumptions: Provisional source15 removes three locating points; draft25 removes five explanatory typing points after retained review. Actual criteria development50 and complete final checks10 stay. Existing native links/sections earn no credit.

Actual evidence/standards owners supply source id/version, method, units, applicability and limitations. Manager selects actual criteria and rationale in s2; absent evidence is obtained manually. No threshold or safeguard is invented. Boundary is development of an internal draft; actual formal adoption/release requires its real separate reviewer/action if assigned.
unknowns: Which standards sections and sources already have native reuse?
research_questions: Can drafted explanations preserve the exact normative force and exceptions of chosen criteria?

incremental.description: Maintain source applicability and explanatory-draft meaning checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 locating plus5 explanatory typing points minus1 upkeep=7. Low: a new resource-protection method needs fresh sources and explanations, leaving only1 familiar-source locating point and1 descriptive typing point removable, minus1=1. Technical decisions and complete final checking remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study forage growth requirements and suitability for particular ranges.

steps.what: Choose forage questions, comparison methods and actual range conditions to study
inputs: actual range conditions and forage question
actual existing forage evidence
outputs: chosen forage study design and measures

steps.what: Study actual forage plants and their growth requirements under relevant range conditions
inputs: chosen forage study design and measures
actual forage plants, plots and conditions
outputs: actual field observations and measured forage responses

steps.what: Capture and check actual forage measurements, plot context, dates and units
inputs: actual field observations and measured forage responses
chosen forage study design and measures
outputs: checked actual forage measurement table

steps.what: Calculate and check chosen forage plot comparisons and summary tables
inputs: checked actual forage measurement table
chosen forage study design and measures
outputs: checked forage comparison tables

steps.what: Determine suitable forage varieties and write/check actual findings and limitations
inputs: checked forage comparison tables
actual field observations and measured forage responses
outputs: checked saved actual forage-suitability findings

tasks.design: Configure the chosen plot-summary calculations and layouts in {SPREADSHEET}. Retain study design, actual plants/conditions, measurement capture, complete comparison checks and scientific variety selection with written findings; existing formula runtime and ordinary saves earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Chosen plot comparison tables may be rebuilt repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formula/table reuse can remove setup without making suitability decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Growth conditions, ecological tradeoffs and representativeness need scientific interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The manager rejects a productive variety unsuited to the actual range conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less comparison-table preparation; forage decisions stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native plot-summary tables can reduce repeated calculation setup while forage trials and suitability judgement remain human.

assumptions: Provisional comparison20 removes six repeated formula/layout preparation points, retaining fourteen review/context points. Already configured calculations/runtime receive no credit. Actual fresh capture20 is explicitly retained and cannot be supplied for free by a template.

Manager records actual plot/range id, species/variety, observation date, growth measure/unit and relevant site conditions after field work. Missing measurements require real follow-up, not imputation by a model. Written scientific choice and ordinary internal save remain fully retained, with no self-approval.
unknowns: Which plot comparisons are already configured and actually repeated?
research_questions: Can summary tables retain plot context and missing-value distinctions without suggesting a variety automatically?

incremental.description: Maintain plot-measure units and chosen comparison-table checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes6 repeated comparison preparation points minus0.7 upkeep=5.3. Low: drought changes the study measures and needs new calculations, leaving only2 stable plot-layout points reusable, minus0.7=1.3. Design, field observations, capture, retained checks and written suitability findings stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop improved rangeland instruments and techniques, including reseeding.

steps.what: Develop actual instrument or reseeding-technique concepts and choose trial criteria
inputs: actual range improvement problem
actual existing instrument/technique evidence
outputs: chosen prototype/technique design and trial criteria

steps.what: Develop and adapt the actual prototype instrument or field technique
inputs: chosen prototype/technique design and trial criteria
actual materials, equipment and site constraints
outputs: actual prototype or adapted field technique

steps.what: Trial the actual instrument or technique and capture real outcomes and conditions
inputs: actual prototype or adapted field technique
chosen prototype/technique design and trial criteria
outputs: actual captured trial measurements and conditions

steps.what: Prepare and check chosen trial outcome comparisons and reseeding performance summaries
inputs: actual captured trial measurements and conditions
chosen prototype/technique design and trial criteria
outputs: checked actual trial comparison table

steps.what: Evaluate actual improvements and write/check development findings and next design changes
inputs: checked actual trial comparison table
actual captured trial measurements and conditions
outputs: checked saved actual development findings and proposed next changes

tasks.design: Configure native trial-summary calculations in {SPREADSHEET} after the manager chooses actual design and performance criteria. Retain concept development, prototype work, real trials/capture and complete evaluation and written design findings in {DOCS}; no instrument design or field result is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated trial comparisons can require fresh table/formula setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Native summary reuse can remove some preparation.
tasks.still_hard: An improved technique must work under actual field constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The manager notices an apparent efficiency gain that harms establishment or usability.
tasks.altitude: A small reduction in trial-summary setup; development judgement stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native trial-summary tables can assist field-instrument development while prototype design and actual trials remain human.

assumptions: Provisional comparison10 removes two repeated setup points, retaining eight comparison-check/context points. Existing formulas/runtime receive zero credit. Actual capture stays within s3, with no uncounted instrumentation or structured-data producer.

Manager supplies actual trial id/date, prototype/technique version, area/unit, seed application/establishment or chosen measure, conditions and method. Missing observations require actual trial work. Future revisions follow s5 rather than feeding earlier steps. Complete written development findings and ordinary ungated save are retained; no new external report/send is assumed.
unknowns: Are trial comparisons stable enough for reuse and already configured?
research_questions: Can summaries preserve conditions and chosen performance criteria across prototype versions?

incremental.description: Maintain trial measure units and summary calculations.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes2 repeated trial-summary setup points minus0.5 upkeep=1.5. Low: a new instrument needs new performance calculations, leaving only1 stable trial-layout point reusable, minus0.5=0.5. Design, prototype work, actual trials/capture and written evaluation retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce eligible permit preparation, selected drafting and repeated trial calculations while retaining range decisions.
role.ambitious_version: Reliable preparation supports managers who retain land, permit and scientific judgement.
